exclusion_rule_verbatim.text: (e) DEGRADED PATH: when the provider cannot supply one of the three fields, the accepted form is a labeled absence of that field. A study that needs the missing field is excluded. The absence is never filled from a ticker, a sector, or a later filing.

exclusion_rule_verbatim.text: (e) DEGRADED PATH: UNKNOWN stays a labeled absence of a rights decision. Collection may continue. Any use that depends on a rights class stays excluded. A successful response is not turned into a class, and this file does not infer one.
